icicle_base.label: Base icicle still; source for the shatter animation.

icicle_shatter.label: Icicle shatter one-shot — 8 frames, 94x94 each, 14fps. Icy chunk burst + frost puff. Source: icicle_base.

penguin_idle.label: Idle loop — 12 frames, 90x90 each, 8fps. Subtle breathing bob + flipper sway + blink.

penguin_slide.label: Slide loop — 8 frames, 90x90 each, 8fps. Right-facing forward lean (mirror via xScale for left).

penguin_hurt.label: Hurt one-shot — 6 frames, 90x90 each, 8fps. Eyes-shut recoil + flippers raised.

penguin_victory.label: Victory one-shot — 10 frames, 90x90 each, 8fps. Arms-up cheer, eyes shut happy.

penguin_icon.label: iOS app icon — penguin sliding on icy slope, pixel-art aesthetic, 1024x1024 opaque. Generated with reference_asset_id=penguin_base.

sky_backdrop.label: Arctic sky backdrop — layered snowy mountains, clouds, icicle corners, snowdrift foreground. Pixel art, 16:9. Downsampled from 5504×3072 raw to 2048×1143 for ship. Used as launch screen AspectFill and in-game SkyBackdrop in GameScene.swift:161.

snow_monster_base.label: Snow Monster boss still — menacing-charming snowman, icicle teeth, glowing blue eyes, branch arms. 76x76 after smart crop. Source for idle/throw/roar animations. reference_asset_id=penguin_base.

snow_monster_idle.label: Snow Monster idle loop — 12 frames, 88x88 each, 8fps. Slow menacing bob, swaying branch arms, snow dust off shoulders. Source: snow_monster_base.
snow_monster_idle.wiring: Verified by penguinslide-gyu.24: imageset PNG sha12 matches, 1056x88 sheet slices cleanly into 12x 88x88 (no bleed). Sliced via Sprite.snowMonsterIdle + EncounterAnimations.monsterIdleFrameCount = 12, nearest-neighbor; looped by SnowMonster at animationFps = 8.

snow_monster_throw.label: Snow Monster wind-up + throw one-shot — 10 frames, 88x88 each, 8fps. Rears back gathering snowball, hurls it toward the camera. Source: snow_monster_base.
snow_monster_throw.wiring: Verified by penguinslide-gyu.24: imageset PNG sha12 matches, 880x88 sheet slices cleanly into 10x 88x88 (no bleed). Sliced via Sprite.snowMonsterThrow + EncounterAnimations.monsterThrowFrameCount = 10. Release recalibrated to this art: ball departs on frame index 8 (SnowMonster.throwReleaseFrameIndex = 8; in-hand 6-7, departure smear 8, follow-through 9) and the throwing hand is the viewer-left arm raised high (SnowMonster.handOffsetFraction = (-0.35, 0.84)).

snow_monster_roar.label: Snow Monster roar/taunt one-shot — 8 frames, 88x88 each, 8fps. Head back, icicle mouth wide, arms shaking, snow bursting off. Source: snow_monster_base.
snow_monster_roar.wiring: Verified by penguinslide-gyu.24: imageset PNG sha12 matches, 704x88 sheet slices cleanly into 8x 88x88 (no bleed). Sliced via Sprite.snowMonsterRoar + EncounterAnimations.monsterRoarFrameCount = 8, one-shot at animationFps = 8.

snow_monster_melt.label: Snow Monster melt outro one-shot — 16 frames, 88x88 each, 8fps. Defeated slump: grin droops sad, icicle teeth drop off, branch arms fall flat, body sinks frame-by-frame into a flat snow puddle/mound; glowing blue eyes fade last (gone after frame 13). Clip is duration-stretched across Tuning.Encounter.meltDuration in-game (not fixed-fps). Source: snow_monster_base.
snow_monster_melt.wiring: Real SpriteCook sheet installed at asset_path (sha12 above) by penguinslide-6m5; EncounterAnimations.monsterMeltFrameCount = 16. Sliced by EncounterAnimations, played by SnowMonster.melt(duration:completion:) stretched across Tuning.Encounter.meltDuration. Frames 14-16 are near-identical settle/hold frames (intentional for the slow-melt hold).

snowball.label: Snowball projectile still — packed snow, bold silhouette, reads small (far) to large (near) for faux-3D scaling. 60x60 after smart crop.
snowball.wiring: Verified by penguinslide-gyu.25: imageset PNG sha matches staging + sha12_local. Delivered as a single 60x60 still (no spin sheet), so the flight bead's manual zRotation spin integration stays (SnowMonsterEncounterSystem.layout, snowballSpinSpeedMin/Max) and EncounterAnimations carries no snowball flight frames. Rendered via Sprite.snowball at snowballBaseSize 64pt camera-plane footprint, nearest-neighbor via SpriteCatalog, depth-scaled through DepthProjector.

snowball_trail.label: Snowball with motion trail variant — streaky trail to upper-left, flying toward viewer. 70x70 after smart crop.
snowball_trail.wiring: Final art delivered, staged only — no imageset yet. Wired by the snowball projectile bead (penguinslide-gyu.13) if a trail variant is used.

papi_penguin_rear.label: Papi Penguin rear view still — back-facing belly slide, matches penguin_base palette/proportions (reference_asset_id=penguin_base). 78x78 after smart crop. Source for rear-slide animation.

papi_penguin_rear_slide.label: Papi Penguin rear-view slide loop — 8 frames, 90x90 each, 8fps. Forward bob with subtle left/center/right lean frames for tilt feedback. Source: papi_penguin_rear.
papi_penguin_rear_slide.dodge_decision: No separate papiRearDodge sheet/case: lean frames are baked into this loop. PapiAvatar mirrors via xScale toward the dodge direction (plan U5 option B).
papi_penguin_rear_slide.lean_decision: Because lean is baked into the frames, PapiAvatar trims its zRotation lean spring target by Tuning.Encounter.papiLeanScale (0.6) so baked + rotated lean don't over-rotate; spring recipe/knobs stay shared with the side-view penguin (gyu.26).
papi_penguin_rear_slide.continuity_qa: Side-by-side vs PenguinSlide sheet (also 8x 90x90): same black body + orange feet palette, same rounded body ratio family; white belly correctly hidden from behind. Reads as the same character (gyu.26).

mountain_backdrop_perspective.label: Snow Monster encounter backdrop — snowy mountain range with one-point perspective valley corridor toward central vanishing point, 16:9, 426x238. reference_asset_id=sky_backdrop for palette consistency.
mountain_backdrop_perspective.wiring: Verified by penguinslide-gyu.25: imageset PNG sha matches staging + sha12_local. Full 426x238 vista (sky + ranges + painted valley floor); in-art horizon row measured at ~y131/238 from top, so EncounterWorld.buildBackdrop anchors at backdropHorizonInArtFraction = 0.45 to pin that row onto DepthProjector.horizonY (Tuning.Encounter.horizonYFraction 0.62 unchanged — geometry truth stays with the projector). Width-fit uniform scale; sky fill above the art top tinted to the art's top-edge sky (RGB ~138/230/249) so the seam is invisible. ART-FEEDBACK: top-left sun glow cannot be continued by the flat fill above the art — acceptable at current scale, revisit if the vista is regenerated taller. Crossfade palette vs SkyBackdrop checked statically (same sky family, reference_asset_id=sky_backdrop); on-device crossfade QA deferred to penguinslide-x06/gyu.29.

ice_ground_perspective.label: Ice ground perspective strip — frozen plane with converging cracks/speed streaks and lateral grooves for scroll-toward-camera motion, 16:9, 426x238. reference_asset_id=sky_backdrop.
ice_ground_perspective.wiring: Verified by penguinslide-gyu.25: imageset PNG sha matches staging + sha12_local. Consumed by EncounterWorld.buildBands as 8 full-width horizontal sub-texture slices (SKTexture(rect:in:), nearest-neighbor) — NOT via SpriteCatalog.tiled, so horizontal tiling is never exercised at runtime. Measured edge continuity anyway: leftmost vs rightmost column mean RGB delta ~27 (max 293) — the perspective plane does NOT tile horizontally; if a future consumer needs SpriteCatalog.tiled, request a dedicated tileable strip from the asset agent. Band smoothness feedback (Mina) tracked separately in penguinslide-hhz.

snowball_impact_base.label: Snowball impact splat still — burst at peak spread, white core + blue-shadowed chunks. 66x66 after smart crop. Source for the burst animation.

snowball_impact_burst.label: Snowball impact burst one-shot — 8 frames, 74x74 each, 8fps. Splat shatters radially, powder puff dissipates to faded final frame. Source: snowball_impact_base.
snowball_impact_burst.wiring: Wired by the impact/dodge FX bead (penguinslide-gyu.16): Sprite.snowballBurst + EncounterAnimations.snowballBurstFrames (8 frames, 8fps, one-shot); played by EncounterFX.playHitBurst anchored on Papi.

encounter_warning_emblem.label: Encounter telegraph UI emblem — gold '!' in rounded triangle badge with icy border and snowman silhouette, mode=ui. 60x60 after smart crop.
encounter_warning_emblem.wiring: Final art delivered, staged only — no imageset yet. Wired by the encounter telegraph/intro bead when the warning UI lands.
